description: This file defines a Lexer class that tokenizes JMESPath expressions, extracting tokens like identifiers, operators, literals, and symbols for parsing purposes.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: A class responsible for tokenizing JMESPath expressions into recognizable tokens used for parsing.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Tokenizes a given JMESPath expression string into an array of tokens with types, positions, and values.

methods.name: matchOr
methods.description: Handles logic to match specific character sequences and determine token types accordingly.

methods.name: inside
methods.description: Collects characters inside delimiters (like quotes or backticks) into a token, handling escapes and unclosed delimiters.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string as JSON, marking the token as unknown if parsing fails.
